titel: First-run Discover promises "you get notified", but permission was never asked in that session and nearby alerts only fire while the app is open

"You're live" is a device-local flag with no lifetime: the moment the app goes to the background the heartbeat stops and everyone else drops you from Live now, while your own screens keep claiming you are live
beleg: SocialSound-Info.plist:21-24 declares only `remote-notification` — no background processing or location mode. The two sync loops are plain `Task { while !Task.isCancelled { … sleep } }` (Services/BroadcastManager.swift:192-210, intervals at :42-43), so they are suspended with the app; NowPlayingView.swift:68-71 additionally stops the player poll on `didEnterBackground`. Viewers compute `isLive = record.isLive && now.timeIntervalSince(lastUpdate) <= maxLiveAge` with `maxLiveAge = 5 * 60` (Features/Discover/ViewModels/DiscoverViewModel.swift:523, 561) and the server flips `isLive:false` after `BROADCAST_LIVE_TTL_MINUTES = 10` (functions/src/index.ts:450, 471-476). Nothing in BroadcastManager observes scenePhase or foreground — the only `willEnterForeground` hook in the flow is NowPlayingView.swift:63-67, and it touches the view model, not the broadcast. The same assumption breaks the idle watchdog: `maxIdlePolls = 40 // ≈ 10 minutes at 15s` (BroadcastManager.swift:49) can only elapse while the user sits in the foreground app with nothing playing.

titel: When the Spotify grant dies while live, the broadcast neither ends nor is mentioned: the heartbeat keeps re-asserting isLive with a frozen track, the idle watchdog can no longer fire, and one UI branch has no way to stop
beleg: On a rejected refresh token, SpotifyAuthManager.swift:163-168 calls `disconnect()` and sets `loginExpired = true` — but never touches BroadcastManager. (The intent is clear elsewhere: the manual Settings disconnect explicitly stops the broadcast first, SettingsContentView.swift:306-319 "This ends your live session.") `loginExpired` is read only in Features/Discover/Views/DiscoverTrackSheet.swift:590, 682 — not on the Live tab, not on the go-live banner, not in BroadcastManager. The idle watchdog cannot help: `if let state = try? await SpotifyService.shared.fetchNowPlayingState()` wraps the whole counter, so a throwing poll never increments `idlePolls` (BroadcastManager.swift:244-257). Worse, `syncTrack` runs regardless and `upsertBroadcast` always writes `"isLive": true` plus a fresh `updatedAt` (BroadcastManager.swift:259, 274-288, 334-368), so the server's staleness sweep (functions/src/index.ts:471-476) can never expire it either. And NowPlayingView.swift:92-93 routes to `spotifyDisconnectedState` (:292-337), which contains no live badge and no `CompactBroadcastToggle` — reachable while broadcasting whenever `vm.currentTrack` is nil (set to nil on `noActiveDevice`, NowPlayingViewModel.swift:73-81).
